name: english-test-platform
description: Monorepo for the English-teaching test/review platform (client + server + shared).

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
